# jamfplatform_pro_delete_user (Action)

Removes a user account from one or more Shared iPads. Every targeted iPad gets the same choice of `user_name` or `delete_all_users`.

A Shared iPad that already has this command waiting keeps that command and queues no other, so a second account you name in the meantime is not removed. Remove one account at a time and wait for each command to finish before sending the next.

The action commands every targeted device in a single request. If Jamf Pro cannot match one device, the whole request fails, no device is commanded and the error does not say which device it was, so a large batch is harder to diagnose than several small ones. Jamf Pro documents no maximum batch size.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Jamf lists this under **Platform environment** scope. You choose an integration's scope when you create it in Jamf Account, and cannot change it afterwards. The provider names the scopes it accepts when you configure it, and for a few families that is wider than Jamf lists here. Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Device actions | Destructive device actions | Execute | `destructive-device-actions` |
| Inventory | Devices | Read | `devices` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "jamfplatform_pro_delete_user" "remove" {
  config {
    serial_numbers = ["F2LXXXXXXXXX"]

    # Name one account, or set delete_all_users = true to remove them all.
    user_name = "alex"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `delete_all_users` (Boolean) Set to `true` to remove every account. Set this or `user_name`.
- `force_deletion` (Boolean) Remove the account even when it has data that has not synced yet. That data is lost.
- `management_ids` (List of String) Jamf Pro Management IDs of the Shared iPads to target. These are the `id` values reported by the `jamfplatform_devices`/`jamfplatform_device` data sources. The action commands all listed Shared iPads in a single request. Set this and/or `serial_numbers`.
- `serial_numbers` (List of String) Serial numbers of the Shared iPads to target (case-sensitive). Each is looked up to find its Management ID before the command is sent, so `management_ids` avoids that lookup. Set this and/or `management_ids`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `user_name` (String) The account to remove. Set this or `delete_all_users`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `invoke` (String) How long the action may run before it is cancelled, as a duration such as `30s` or `10m`. Defaults to 5 minutes.
